articles.author: Mark k
articles.description:
On a recent project my team used a conversational model to generate unit tests for a core data transformation pipeline. We prompted the model with function signatures, a few example inputs, and an informal spec; the tool returned a set of pytest-style tests that looked reasonable at a glance. Because the tests executed cleanly and CI went green, we shipped the change with confidence.
The problem showed up later when a production edge case triggered wrong outputs that none of the generated tests caught. The tests were syntactically correct and exercised functions, but they asserted the wrong properties: equality on serialized outputs instead of structural invariants, hard-coded timestamps, and mocks that masked timing behavior. We had effectively converted the model’s priors about common te…
articles.title: When Generated Tests Pass but Miss the Bug: A Case of False Confidence from AI Test Generation

articles.description:
How to Calculate Someone's Net Worth


Net worth is a fundamental measure of financial health, representing the difference between what a person owns and what they owe. Whether you're evaluating your own finances, considering a joint financial venture, or simply curious, understanding how to calculate net worth is a valuable skill. Here’s a step-by-step guide to doing it accurately.
The calculation is straightforward:
Net Worth = Total Assets – Total Liabilities
Assets are everything of value that you own. Liabilities are all your debts and financial obligations. A positive net worth means your assets exceed your liabilities, while a negative net worth indicates you owe more than you own.
Begin by cataloging everything you own that has monetary value. Assets are typically categorized as ei…
articles.title: How to calculate someone's networth

articles.description:
Avoid These Team-Building Mistakes as a New Entrepreneur


Building a team is one of the most crucial steps for any first-time entrepreneur. Yet, many unknowingly stumble into common pitfalls. Avoid these mistakes to set your startup on the path to success.
Rushing the Hiring Process


In a rush to get their projects off the ground, new entrepreneurs often hasten through key hiring decisions. This can lead to a mismatch in skills or company culture. Take the time to clearly define the roles you're hiring for and carefully vet candidates. Remember, the right fit is worth the wait.
Overlooking Diversity


Diversity isn’t just a buzzword; it’s a competitive advantage. Teams that bring together different perspectives are more innovative and effective. Avoid building a team that looks just like you—embrace diversity in skills, backgrounds, and ideas to foster creativity and resilience.
Neglecting AI-Powered Tools


In the digital age, technology is your ally. First-time entrepreneurs often overlook AI tools like LeKlub-AI, which can intelligently match you with potential co-founders and key team members, ensuring a complementary skill set and shared vision. This strategic use of AI can save time and increase your chances of startup success.
Building a robust team is an evolving process. By avoiding these common mistakes, you can create a foundation for a successful venture. Ready to build your dream team? Explore LeKlub-AI to find your perfect co-founder today and turn your vision into reality.
articles.title: Avoid These Team-Building Mistakes as a New Entrepreneur
